I use `click.Path(resolve_path=True)` for a CLI option, and when the path is a symlink whose target is a relative filename, the value I get back is wrong. I expect the absolute path of the real file, but instead I get a path based on my current working directory, so it points to a different location. For example:

```python
@click.command()
@click.option("--p", type=click.Path(resolve_path=True))
def cli(p):
    click.echo(p)
```

```console
$ mkdir -p /tmp/demo && cd /tmp/demo
$ touch real.txt
$ ln -s real.txt link
$ cd /
$ cli --p /tmp/demo/link
/real.txt        # I expected /tmp/demo/real.txt
```

Absolute symlink targets seem to resolve correctly; only relative ones come out wrong.
